content.title: Virgin Galactic misses on Q3 revenue, Bristol Myers halts drug trial
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Virgin Galactic (SPCE) shares rising while missing third quarter revenue estimates and narrowing its net losses below forecasts, Applied Materials (AMAT) forecasting a drop in chip equipment sales, and Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) halting its trial for a blood clot drug.
